name: Lycoris
source:
Lycoris, a clone distinctly crafted for Project Yggdrasil, stood out with her unique violet eyes, differing from Nerine. She had an encounter with Rin in the human world before the principal events of the story. Tragically, she met an untimely end. Upon her passing, Lycoris's memories were transferred to Nerine, bequeathing her not just a melodious singing voice but also her profound affection for Rin.

Before her departure, Lycoris shared her tender tale about Rin with Primula, igniting the young girl's interest in him. Although not bound by blood, Primula held Lycoris close to her heart as a sister. In a gesture of affection, Lycoris passed on a treasured stuffed cat she had received from Rin to Primula.
